title.narrative: Integrated Pathways for Labour Market Inclusion (IP4LMI)

description.narrative:
1- Increase employment opportunities for vulnerable groups, with a special focus on: young people not in employment and not in education, people with disabilities, beneficiaries of the cash assistance and young mothers not in employment through active employment programmes, introduction of integrated case management approaches and guidelines, self-employment and social enterprises initiatives.

2- Improve access and quality of vocational skills development, career guidance and life skills training through provision of training, mentoring and coaching in close cooperation with the vocational schools, vocational training centres toward skills development.

3- Promote and support accessibility and new models of supported employment for people with disabilities at the regional employment offices and outreach through active labour measures or similar measures.
